privileged_info_for_vlm: The reference date for Recency calculations is 2011-12-01. The source data is located at ~/Documents/Spreadsheets/online_retail_q4.csv. The output must be an ONLYOFFICE spreadsheet at ~/Documents/Spreadsheets/rfm_segmentation.xlsx. Scoring thresholds: R (4: <=15, 3: 16-30, 2: 31-60, 1: >60); F (4: >=15, 3: 6-14, 2: 2-5, 1: 1); M (4: >=500, 3: 150-499, 2: 50-149, 1: <50). Segments: Champions (11-12), Loyal (8-10), At Risk (5-7), Lost (3-4).
